༄༅/ /phyugs nad srung gso'i man ngag zab dgu bsdus pa bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// phyugs nad srung gso'i man ngag zab dgu bsdus pa bzhugs//

phyugs nad srung ba'i tsakra ni/ don rnam pa bzhi ste/ tsakra bri ba dang*/ rdzas dang*/ rab gnas dang*/ btags pa'o// dang po tsakra bri ba ni/ shog bu la mu khyud bzhi ldan rtsibs bzhi dang ldan pa bris pa'i lte bar/ phyugs 'di srungs shig rak+ṣa zhes bri/ rtsibs la/ rā tsa e na zlog /yar ma dur lu zlog /haṃ ra ra ni zlog /nā ga zlog /rtsibs mchan la/ hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ mu khyud la ye dharmā bri/ de'i phyir rdor ra me ri bri/ rgyab tu sku gsung thugs gyi snying po bri/ rdza~Xs skya ga skyung ka /srin bya rnams kyi sgro srung ba'i g.yas g.yon du 'jug /rā tsa e na zlog gi sngags dang rten 'brel snying pos ra~Xb tu gnas pa byas pa'i srung ba mi lag mi brgyud par/ phyugs kyi rwa phrag tu bta~Xgs pas gor gyi rigs thams cad thub par 'gyur ro// gter ston khams pa me zor can gyis brag rgya bo nas bton/ de nas gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug la brgyud pa'o/ / oṃ swasti/ gor srung ba ni/ spyi don rnam pa bzhi ste/ dang po byung khungs bstan pa/ gnyis pa bri thabs bstan pa/ gsum pa rdzas bya thabs bstan pa/ bzhi pa rab gnas bstan pa'o// dang po byung khungs ni/ gter ston khams pa me zor gyis/ mang yul spyi lding lha khang nas bton pa'o// gnyis pa bri thabs bstan pa ni/ shog bu gtsang ma la tsakra dpe chung ltar bris te/ dang po phyugs bres su sba/ gnyis pa sgo khyi'i mjug ma la btag /gsum pa rdzas kyis byugs te khyu mchog gcig gi mgul du btag /de la ji ltar bri ba ni 'di yin te/ (ka) dang po phyugs bres su mnan pa'i tsakra ni/ sdig pa'i lto bar god 'dre'i ling ga bris pa'i tha mar gnod byed gshin 'dre/ gson 'dre/ the'u rang pe dkar 'gong po gnod byed s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bri/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ ru ru dha dha gung ku ma ye swā hā/ zhes bzla/ (kha) gnyis pa sgo khyi'i mjug mar btag pa ni/

ral gri'i dkyil du/ ā+om̐ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa phyugs kyi god 'dre god sri thams cad gtubs/ bri/ rdo rje zhags pa'i dkyil du/ oṃ na mo nī lam bha ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyugs kyi god 'dre god sri thams cad kha chings/ kha tham s+t+wam bha ya nan/ zhes bri/ (ga) gsum pa khyu mchog gi mgul du 'dogs pa ni/ 'khor lo mu khyud lnga bskor/ rtsibs brgyad lte ba la phyugs 'di rnams la nad thams cad srungs shig /mu khyud nang mar ā li bri/ rtsibs brgyad la/ oṃ bhur kuṃ ma hā ma hā ga na/ ghu dza ghu dza/ bhi ma la se/ bha ha kro ta/ oṃ tsa ku mi ma/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rtsibs mchan la mā ra ya sod/ mā ra ya byings/ mā ra ya myogs/ mā ra ya rmugs/ mā ra ya gtubs/ bha ya thum raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ phyugs nad gnod byed rak+ṣa/ mu khyud phyi ma la ye dharmā bri/ de'i phyi la/ phyugs la gnod byed mā ra ya sod/ byings/ myogs/ rmugs/ gtubs/ ril ril rak+ṣa/ zhes bri ༈ gsum pa rdzas bstan pa ni/ dang po srung ba'i rdzas la/ khyi mjug gi spu phyi bsgril byas nas bcing*/ gnyis pa la rdzas med/ gsum pa la/ btsan dug /gu gul/ shing kun/ spru nag rtsa ba/ mu zi nag po/ gla rtsi/ shu dag rnams sbyar nas tsakra dang bcas bstums nas btag ༈ /bzhi pa rab gnas ni/ dang po sdig pa mgo mjug sprad/ sngags brgya rtsa bzlas la bres su gnon/ gnyis pa sgo khyi'i mjug mar btag /gsum pa khyu mchog gi mgul du 'dogs/ rab tu gnas pa spyi ltar byed/ zab rgya/ zab rgya/ ༈ /yang gor srung ni/ sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ta ru ta ru hūm̐ phaṭa: gor lod gha ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa: skyer pa'i 'bru sdig pa'i sha gnyis la btab sbyar la gtong bas bsrung ngo: zab rgya: : ༈ byang gter thugs sgrub las tshogs las/ gor nad srung gso'i man ngag zab mo gud du phyung ba bzhugs/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag nyid ni:

bod kyi btsad pos spyan drangs yong ba'i dus: bod kyi lha srin tshogs nas bar chad bya bar brtsams: nga nyid 'jigs bral rdo rje'i sku la glags ma nus: thams cad dam la btags shing tshar yang bcad: de dus brtan ma bcu gnyis gtso mo yis: rang rtags srog snying mdongs gsol dag tu phul: e ma slob dpon chen po lags: lan gcig dus kyi tha ma la: gnag lug ba glang ra sogs la: snang srid ma mo 'khrugs nas nad rnams gtong: gor dang dkar chags tshad rims sogs: gnag lug ra rnams dmyal thag gcod: de dus man ngag 'di yis sos par 'gyur: zhes zer nas phul lo: gor gyi rigs gsum gang yin yang: (1) rten 'brel rdzas kyi srung ba ni: gri sha btsan dug shu dag dang: mu zi sgog pa gcig por skyes: spyang khyi phag pa wa yi brun: rdzas brgyad mi yi pags par bstum: yang na khyi lpags dag kyang rung: gang bsrung ske ru 'og gi sngags thum dang lhan gcig/ gdags par bya: (2) nus pa sngags kyi srung ba ni: oṃ bha ra dha swa bha ma la kun bhi la dza la ya: oṃ saṃ bha yā: bhi ma la swā hā: ghi haṃ cu gang chu ru sbyar: brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas sna ru blug: (3) khyad par btags te srung ba ni: gza' dang tshes skar bzang po la: gser btso sbyar ba'i snag tshwa yis: oṃ khrag nyal a raṃ sod: tshar gcig bri la brgya rtsa sngags: dril la rang gi lci bas bstum: rtsid pa'i g.yag rgod/ srad bus rgya gram dkri: gang la bsrung ba de la btag: gsum rdzas/ sngags chu/ srung ba/ gyis mi thub mi srid do: (4) byung ba 'chos na dge slong bzhis: thun du byas nas sngags pa'i chu: kha snar blug cing gtor bar bya: oṃ nir sing yeṃ rbad swā hā: gol yor la'o: oṃ tri ta ma ra du swā hā: lhog yor la'o: snang phob gzhab ta swā hā: glo yor la'o: hring ni la kha ṭha ṭha oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: spyi la sngags 'di'o// zhes pa'i sngags chu gtang bar bya'o:

srung ba'i sngags dang bzlas shing btang: (5)gong gi thabs byas kyang ma thub par/ nan ltar 'gos 'chi 'dug gyur na: gong gi rdzas brgyad bsreg cing bdug: stag ras yungs dkar dag la yang: sngags 'di zhag bdun bzlas la gdags: oṃ badz+ra bha ra tri ma hā ni: 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa: de yis thub par the tshom med: rgyal ba'i gsung bsgrag gtor ma gtong: khrus kyi bya bas mi gtsang bsal: mkhan skya'i mdos bya ma mo bskang: mkhon dang mi gtsang 'dre can bsrung: dud 'gro nad las thar bar 'gyur: zhes phul: slob dpon gyis ma 'ongs pa'i sems can gyi don du dpe ma bur bkod de so sor sbas so: ༈ glo gor hon gsum srung ba ni: oṃ tad+ya thā: a li ma da le hab dar dza ran tsan dha dza me a ra ha ha de he ka ni tsa rug ma ni bya li bya ye swā hā: oṃ ha ha ma ru swā hā: oṃ tri tri ma du swā hā: zhes tshag med phreng gcig bri: bzang drug: dpa' ser: yung ba ser po rnams byug: pho g.yas mo g.yon du btags pas thub bo: rig 'dzin las 'phro gling pa'i gter ma'o/ ༈ kha tsha srung ba'i sngags ni/ tho rangs dus su rang nyid klu bdud sbal pa dkar po gcig tu gsal ba'i kha nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar nar gyis babs par bsam la sngags chu bya'o// oṃ nā ga rā tsa kha la swā hā/ tho rangs snga bar blud pas phan/ yang na/ oṃ a dha yang shu la swā hā/ mtshal dkar dang mar sbyar ba la sngags nas rwa dang rmig pa la bsku'o/ ༈ /lug nad srung ba dang gcod pa'i gdams pa 'ga' zhig bzhugs/ lug nad zhi bar byed pa'i man ngag ni/ oṃ dkar lam thib/ dug lam thib/ dug pra mo ri tis thib/ tri ti mu ni thib/ ma yam khug /ma yam zhig /'dra tal phyis/ khyi thal shig /phrag dog gi 'dre tal zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ chu gtsang ma la brgya bzlas sngags chu ster zhing gtor bas thub cing chod/ gshin rje zla gsang gi las tshogs las byung ba zab// yang lug nad zhi bar byed na/

bye ma gtsang ma dang*/ nyungs dkar la sngags brgya stong btab gtor bas chad par 'gyur ro// oṃ kha la me 'bar/ lce la glog 'khyug /thug la thog 'dril/ lug nad tal pa'i snying phyungs swā hā/ rang nyid bram ze rgan po lce la me dpung 'bar ba bsgom/ me'i tshwa tshwas bsregs par bsgom pa'o// zab bo// rgya rgya rgya/ lug nad gcod pa'i thabs la/ bya khyung gzugs bag zan la legs par bcos/ btsag gis byug /rin po che'i snod nang nas kyis bkang la de'i steng gzhug /gtor ma gsum bsham/ gcig bla ma yi dam la 'bul/ nad yams zhi bar gsol ba btab/ gcig bya khyung dang chos skyong la 'bul/ nad gcod pa'i phrin las bcol/ gcig nad bdag dang bgegs rigs la sbyin/ gnod pa mi byed par bsgo/ sngags bzlas shing byang shar nas bya khyung byon/ lug la bskor zhing*/ lug nad thams cad med par byas/ zhi bar byas/ nad gdon yul du med par byas/ phyogs na yang med par byas par bsam/ oṃ bya khyung rgyal po sku skyod 'tshal: lug nad tel pa thams cad chod: nad yams chod la gdon god chod: mkha' 'gro ma yi dal yams chod: oṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: sngags chu byin zhing phyugs lhas gtor: gtor ma bya khyung lho nub mtshams su bskyal: lug nad rbad kyis chad par 'gyur: : rat+na gling pa'i gter phran no/// /
